headline: Philippine Air Force Completes 32-Helicopter Black Hawk Acquisition
seoTitle: PAF Completes 32 S-70i Black Hawk Acquisition | FMB News
seoDescription: The Philippine Air Force completed delivery of 32 S-70i Black Hawk helicopters after accepting the final seven aircraft.
deck: The final seven S-70i helicopters completed a 32-aircraft acquisition intended to expand transport, rescue and disaster-response capacity.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Philippine Air Force completed delivery of its 32-aircraft S-70i Black Hawk acquisition after formally accepting the final seven helicopters at Villamor Air Base.
The aircraft were acquired under the Armed Forces modernization program.

sections.heading: What the fleet is for
paragraphs: The Air Force said the helicopters support troop and cargo transport, humanitarian assistance and disaster response, search and rescue, and medical evacuation.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The final delivery strengthened an existing Black Hawk fleet and expanded the service's rotary-wing capacity for operations across the archipelago.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: The next phase is operational integration, crew training and assignment of the additional aircraft to missions and units.
